# T3: Scale's rectangle mode on legacy's own text measure
# (visual_t3_capture.cpp built with PROBE_LEGACY_MEASURE, target
# legacy_visual_t3_measure_capture). The view is the T3 cases' (a 1280x720
# frame in a 640x400 client, the script 1920x1080, coefficient 3); every
# Style is Titillium Web (the Qt examples' TitilliumWeb-Regular.ttf and
# TitilliumWeb-Bold.ttf, given to the probe and to HikariSub's test as
# installed fonts).
#
# Each Scale case: the tool with the rectangle, both axes and the original
# rectangle (27: GetTextSize gives originalSize and the border, and
# SetSecondRectScale draws the measured rectangle), a left drag that draws the
# target rectangle in the free top-left corner (SetScale writes \fscx and
# \fscy from it against the original rectangle), the original rectangle
# turned off (11: ChangeTool measures the scaled text again) and a second
# rectangle drawn (the scale from originalSize).

case measure-plain
client 640 400 40
frame 1280 720 0 1
rect 0 0 640 360
script 1920 1080
time 1500
fps 25
style Default 60 100 100 0 2 2 7 20 20 20
stylefont 0 0 0 Titillium Web
line 1000 2000 Default 0 0 0 0|{\pos(900,600)}Hello world
active 0
tool scale 27
state
press 20 20 left
move 100 60 left
move 180 110 left
release 180 110 left
state
option 11
state
press 600 340 left
move 500 250 left
release 500 250 left
state
end

# The empty Line after a measured one: GetTextSize returns at once without
# writing the border, so Scale keeps the previous Line's (T3-empty-line-border).
case measure-empty-line
client 640 400 40
frame 1280 720 0 1
rect 0 0 640 360
script 1920 1080
time 1500
fps 25
style Default 60 100 100 0 2 2 5 20 20 20
stylefont 0 0 0 Titillium Web
line 1000 2000 Default 0 0 0 0|{\pos(960,540)\bord5\shad3}Before
line 1000 2000 Default 0 0 0 0|
active 0
tool scale 27
state
active 1
setvisual
state
end

# GetDialogueAdditionalPosition (keepExtraLead, the extra lead kept) on
# Lines stacked without \pos: RotationZ on the active Line and an
# unpositioned one, as rotz-org-stacked.
case measure-stacked
client 640 400 40
frame 1280 720 0 1
rect 0 0 640 360
script 1920 1080
time 1500
fps 25
style Default 60 100 100 0 2 2 2 20 20 20
stylefont 0 0 0 Titillium Web
style Top 45 120 100 0 1 1 8 20 20 30
stylefont 1 0 0 Titillium Web
line 1000 2000 Default 0 0 0 0|First bottom line
line 1000 2000 Default 0 0 0 0|{\bord4}Second\Nbottom
line 1000 2000 Top 0 0 0 0|Top one
line 1000 2000 Default 0 0 0 0|Third bottom
line 1000 2000 Default 0 0 0 0|{\pos(960,540)}Active
active 4
select 3 4
tool rotz 0
press 320 180 left
move 335 170 left
release 335 170 left
state
end
